reviews.author: Jesse Squicciarino
reviews.text: Cesco is the man! I contacted him with a ton of parts that I needed installed on my Audi. He gave me an estimate, and fit me on his schedule right away. He’s honest, and I highly recommend him to anyone looking to have work done. Thank you for everything you do, Cesco!

reviews.author: Nikolay Prodanov
reviews.text: I’m so happy because finally I found the place where I completely can trust the people working there. Cesco is one of the best mechanics I met in my life- very professional, honest and responsible. I recommend their services to anyone who wants their car to be cared for the same as their loved ones.

reviews.author: Diana Davis
reviews.text: I highly recommend this mechanic. He owns his own business and you can truly tell he takes pride in his work. He is honest, hardworking, and upfront about what your car actually needs. He explains everything clearly, doesn’t try to overcharge, and gets the job done right. It’s hard to find someone you can trust with your vehicle, and he’s definitely one of those people. I’ll be coming back and recommending him to family and friends.

reviews.author: Jeremiah Gregory
reviews.text: Had my coilover suspension installed by cessco and couldn't be happier with the results. Very friendly and quality service. He even found the my thermostat is leaking ( which Goodyear failed to find in their "100 point inspection" ). Will definitely be back for different work and would recommend him to any one.

reviews.author: Juan Javier Darquea
reviews.text: Cesco is amazing! He gave me a great price and did an incredible job with my audi q3 that needed a water pump replacement. He is honest and will not try to sell you services you don’t actually need. Highly recommended!!

reviews.author: Chandler Hummell
reviews.text: GREAT WORK! Alfa Romeos can be a really difficult car to work on. Even more difficult is finding somebody willing to do the work outside of an AR dealership. Alfa wanted to charge me about 5x the amount that Cesco did. Not only did it save a ton of money, but I got upgraded brakes and didn't even have to travel far. Also scheduled me quick !! Super genuine guy and a solid car tech. So glad I found this place!!! Btw, he has the full ECU software for any new Alfa Romeo, so no need to fret about weird limp-mode mishaps. Thanks Cesco!!!

reviews.author: Brian Dore
reviews.text: You can't find this kind of honest service anymore! Always amazing support and customer service from the team. They have taken care of my family's vehicles on multiple occasions and helped get us back on the road without worrying about getting hassled out taken advantage of.

reviews.author: Michael LaPorte
reviews.text: I am a big fan of people who do what they tell you they are going to do. Cesco at EAS is one of those people. He does quality work at a fair price, and doesn’t look to find things that “need to be fixed” when they really don’t. I took my Mercedes to him once the service agreement ran out and the dealer on Fording Island wanted to charge me a premium to use their techs. It’s not hard - do a good job and charge a fair price, and that’s what they do at European Auto Service.

reviews.author: Ken Hilliard
reviews.text: Will not take my European Suv's or Maserati anywhere else. Having him is why I bought the last two, honestly.

reviews.author: Mary Ghattas
reviews.text: I’ve been taking my vehicle to Cesco for almost a year now. Great service always, excellent communication and truly reasonable rates. Worthy mention, I have taken my Volkswagen to other shops in town that service German/European vehicles and haven’t received nearly half the quality of service that I received at Cesco’s. Overall, I am very happy with my experience at European Auto Service.

reviews.author: Manuela Salda
reviews.text: Cesco was a total life saver! We were mid road trip only in town for a few days and he was able to source a part that our car needed and expedite a repair to get us back on the road in time.

reviews.author: Quinton Brantley
reviews.text: Thanksgiving I was headed from Charlotte to Bluffton to enjoy some family time when my alternator bit the dust. I called every garage in town with decent ratings. Cesco was the first one of two to respond even though they were closed. He confirmed that he would be able to take care of my needs set a time and exceeded my expectations. Great communication and a pleasure to do business with and was at a reasonable rate. Thanks Cesco!

reviews.author: Ryan Baranello
reviews.text: For any Volkswagen, Audi, etc. in need of maintenance, head over to European Auto Service, the mechanic Cesco is very capable of getting nearly anything you need to be done fast and cheap. My car broke down on the highway and was towed back to my house and he was able to come out to me and fix my car in the parking lot, he has done a full alignment and tire rotation, multiple oil changes, and more. Great customer service and always willing to help when he can.

reviews.author: David Schmidt
reviews.text: I got nothing but good comments about this place. Cesco is reliable and a great mechanic. He has the utmost integrity, in my opinion, which is something important to me. I will come back for anything my car needs.

reviews.author: William Rooney
reviews.text: Called around all town just trying to get some wrist pin snap rings and the soonest I could get them was a few days out. Then I called them and they said had some used ones they’d give me and they followed through. Great guys and super nice!

reviews.author: Teresa Schoch
reviews.text: After a few unsuccessful attempts to determine the cause of my Jag’s failure to start, I was directed here. Not only was the cause quickly determined, the price was fair and the work excellent. I highly recommend European Auto Service and am happy I was able to find competence with honesty. Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Orien Crook
reviews.text: The man who runs this shop is literally a blessing I was coming down from out of state. And my serpentine belt popped on my s5. Called all the local shops and no one seemed like they knew what they were doing. When I called and he said it’s a simple fix and that he had the Belt in stock [which is rare ] he took care of it with ease and even came in on his off. Day! Keep on grinding!

reviews.author: Brad Spencer
reviews.text: Cesco and the guys at European Auto service are great, helped me out even when they were busy. And gave me more information than most people would. Would highly recommend!

reviews.author: J Hudson Williams
reviews.text: We cannot say enough great things about Cesco!!! Professional, exceptionally knowledgeable & timely!! We’re so pleased to have found him for our 2 BMWs & Volvo!

reviews.author: Thomas Withers
reviews.text: I was so glad to be referred to Cesco over at European Auto Services! He did a fantastic job repairing my Audi and I will be using him for all my repair / services going forward.

reviews.author: E. Anthony
reviews.text: I accidentally contacted this shop instead of the one that worked on my car, on a Saturday no less. The owner STILL helped me trouble shoot my issue. That speaks volumes, I will definitely be coming here in the future! Thank you

reviews.author: Miles Childers
reviews.text: Service is excellent, Jeff is professional and very knowledgeable. He takes pride in the auto service he delivers. Number 1 European Auto Service Provider.

reviews.author: Tes Reed
reviews.text: I want to gatekeep this shop but I won’t. Very HONEST and TRUSTWORTHY. I recommend this shop to anyone wanting to stay away from the upsell hell that comes from commercial shops.

reviews.author: Lisa Fahoury
reviews.text: Was so glad to be referred to Cesco at European Auto Service for my MINI -- they're my go-to for service from now on.

reviews.author: Karl Opperman
reviews.text: Service was timely and way cheaper that taking my maserati to the dealer. Very professional and knowledgeable.

reviews.author: Rickson Amorim
reviews.text: Called a few times, nobody answered the phone neither call back. That was the only experience I had with them so far.
